title: Gold Label Annotation
description: Annotation format for gold-set documents in the Bloomsbury Network Mapper corpus.

annotator.description: Identifier of the person or system that created this annotation

annotation_date.description: ISO 8601 date when annotation was created

document_type.description: Category of document (e.g. mixed, financial_statement, trustee_filing, accounts_only)

quality_notes.description: Optional free-text notes on annotation quality or document issues

entity_id.description: Unique identifier within this document (e.g. E1, E2)

raw_value.description: Exact text as it appears in the document

normalised_value.description: Cleaned and standardised form of the entity value

span_start.description: Character offset where entity begins in the document

span_end.description: Character offset where entity ends in the document

evidence_span.description: Surrounding context text that contains the entity

attributes.description: Type-specific attributes (e.g. role for persons, charity_number for organisations)

role.description: Role of a person entity (e.g. trustee, director, accountant)

charity_number.description: Charity Commission registration number for an organisation

company_number.description: Companies House registration number for an organisation

date_format.description: Original format of a date entity (e.g. DD/MM/YYYY)

currency.description: Currency code for a monetary_amount entity

relationship_id.description: Unique identifier within this document (e.g. R1, R2)

relationship_type.description: The type of relationship between entities

source_entity_id.description: References an entity_id in the entities array

target_entity_id.description: References an entity_id in the entities array

valid_from.description: ISO 8601 date when the relationship started, or null if unknown

valid_to.description: ISO 8601 date when the relationship ended, or null if ongoing/unknown

donation_id.description: Unique identifier within this document (e.g. D1, D2)

donor_entity_id.description: References an entity_id in the entities array

recipient_entity_id.description: References an entity_id in the entities array

amount.description: Donation amount, or null if not specified

year.description: Year of the donation, or null if not specified
